name: STULZ CyberHandler 2 size S11 indirect evaporative AHU
description: Outdoor packaged air handler with indirect air-to-air heat exchanger, adiabatic cooling and optional chilled-water or DX top-up; largest of 11 sizes. Returns data-hall air without mixing it with outside air.

capacity_w.note: nominal net cooling 206 kW at 40,450 m3/h; supply air 25 C with 15 K delta-T, 50 Pa ESP, ambient 35.8 C DB / 22.3 C WB. Maximum net capacity 531 kW at 113,050 m3/h

power_w.note: nominal capacity / EER = 206 kW / 18.13 = 11.36 kW total unit input (fans + adiabatic pumps) at nominal conditions

capacity_max_w.note: max net cooling capacity at max airflow

airflow_m3_s.note: nominal data-center airflow 40,450 m3/h; max 113,050 m3/h (31.4 m3/s)

weight_kg.note: vendor estimate; depends on cooling/installation configuration

ppue_annual.note: annual pPUE, London Heathrow weather, nominal conditions

sources.title: STULZ CyberHandler 2 brochure (technical data and nomenclature)
